subject: BluePeak marketplace listing & co-sell operational checklist
body:
From: Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. BluePeak is ready to move forward with a joint listing and co-sell engagement across GCP + AWS, but our channel team needs a concise operational checklist and the minimum technical evidence Redwood requires for co-sell certification.

Can you share:
- The production evidence bundle you need for listing (SOC2 excerpts, network topology, dataflow diagram).
- Any SKU/price commitment guidance for initial marketplace visibility.
- The expected timeline once we submit the intake package to the marketplace teams.

We'd like to align on a mutual action plan for the next 3 weeks. Attaching our internal GTM deck for context (sent separately).

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Partnerships
BluePeak Analytics
[Attachment: bp-g2m-deck.pdf (PDF)]

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Hi Elena — great to hear you're ready. Looping in Ben (partnerships ops) and Olga (technical evidence) to put together a short checklist.

High level we need:
1) Technical evidence zip (runtime screenshots, model manifest, endpoint URL + example request/response)
2) Security docs (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS note, data retention policy)
3) Listing metadata (SKU names, short/long descriptions, logo assets, contact email)
4) Co-sell ask: preferred regions, target launch date, any marketplace incentives requested

Ben/Olga — can you draft our checklist and estimate how long the intake -> publish path takes for AWS and GCP (and any differences for co-sell eligibility)?

Priya
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Elena — happy to run point on ops. Quick notes:
- AWS vs GCP: AWS requires the marketplace intake form + at least one pricing SKU to go live. Co-sell enablement on AWS often needs a partner request to the field seller enablement team; that can add ~1-2 weeks after listing.
- GCP tends to require the technical evidence bundle and a separate listing approval; co-sell tagging is handled by their partner sales team and can be ~2 weeks post-listing.

I've started a concise checklist (attached). Olga, can you confirm the minimum set of artifacts and whether we should ask BluePeak for a sample inference trace?

Next steps I propose:
1) BluePeak to upload tech evidence (bp-tech-evidence.zip) + logo assets to the Drive link.
2) Redwood to fill marketplace intake templates and send to AWS/GCP ops.
3) Run a 30-min tech QA (Ben/Olga + BluePeak eng) to validate endpoints and examples.

[Attachment: co-sell-checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

-ben
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Thanks — Elena, I reviewed BluePeak's initial packet and a couple of asks:
- Please include a minimal OpenAPI snippet or a curl example that shows token-based auth and a 5-token sample response. That will help our runtime team validate compatibility.
- Provide a short note on data residency for the inference logs (where they store payloads and for how long).
- If possible, include a GPU instance class you recommend for the demo (we've seen c6-instances, a2/ga2 equivalents on GCP).

I attached a template for the evidence bundle and a checklist of quick acceptance tests we run during QA. If BluePeak can upload bp-tech-evidence.zip to the Drive folder by EoD Monday, we can target an intake submission on Tuesday.

- Olga
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-template.txt (Text)]

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Quick alignment for timelines:
- BluePeak uploads evidence by EoD Monday (19 Oct).
- Redwood to complete AWS + GCP intake templates and submit Tues (20 Oct).
- Marketplace ops response window: ~3-7 business days, co-sell tagging after listing ~7-14 business days depending on field coordination.

Elena — can we lock a 30-min tech QA slot this week? Ben/Olga/Connor will attend. I put three time options in the Drive scheduling doc (link below).

Priya

---
From: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Elena Moro <elena@bluepeak.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood listing visibility & co-sell pre-reqs

Hello Priya and team,

Thanks for the heads up. Once you submit the intake, please include the following fields on the AWS portal: contact email, pricing SKU (USD), AMER/EU region flags, and the short description under 400 chars. We will review within 72 hours for listing eligibility. For co-sell consideration please mark the "Partner Co-Sell" checkbox and include any joint GTM notes.

Intake link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
[Automated intake acknowledgment will follow after submission]
